sourcesMenu.Name: Content Sources
sourcesMenu.Label: Choose Compendium Packs
sourcesMenu.Hint: Point the wizard at the compendium packs to use. With none checked it uses the dnd5e Compendium Browser sources.

spellRulesMenu.Name: Spell Rules
spellRulesMenu.Label: Configure Spell Rules
spellRulesMenu.Hint: Per-class spell counts, casting type, spell list, and replacements used by the spell step.

artworkMenu.Name: Artwork
artworkMenu.Label: Configure Artwork
artworkMenu.Hint: Assign splash images or background videos to classes, subclasses, species, and backgrounds.

theme.Name: Theme
theme.Hint: Look of the wizard. Oblivion uses parchment pages, inked text, and bronze frames inspired by The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion's menus.

birthsignStep.Name: Birthsign Step
birthsignStep.Hint: Show the Birthsign screen (after Species). Signs come from any compendium feat of type Birthsign, including the bundled Birthsigns of Tamriel.

birthsignDrawbacks.Name: Birthsign Drawbacks
birthsignDrawbacks.Hint: Apply the optional Oblivion-style drawbacks of signs like the Lord and the Apprentice.

stepBackdrops.Name: Scene Backdrops
stepBackdrops.Hint: Show a bundled landscape behind each step (class, species, abilities, ...). Art you assign to a specific option still takes priority.

contentRules.Name: Rules Edition
contentRules.Hint: Which edition's content to offer. "Follow system" uses the dnd5e Rules Version setting.

hideSrdDuplicates.Name: Prefer Premium Content
hideSrdDuplicates.Hint: Hide the system's SRD copy of an option when a book module or import provides the same one.

allowLevelChoice.Name: Players Choose Starting Level
allowLevelChoice.Hint: Show a level picker on the class screen.

maxStartingLevel.Name: Highest Selectable Starting Level
maxStartingLevel.Hint: Upper limit for the level picker.

abilityManual.Name: Allow Manual Entry
abilityManual.Hint: Lets players type any score from 3 to 18.

rollsToChat.Name: Post Rolls to Chat
rollsToChat.Hint: Ability and starting-gold rolls are posted publicly (and shown by Dice So Nice).

allowReroll.Name: Allow Rerolls
allowReroll.Hint: Let players reroll ability scores and starting gold.

hpMode.Name: Hit Points After Level 1
hpMode.Hint: How hit points are gained for levels after the first.
hpMode.Prompt: Let the player choose or roll

multiclassPrereqs.Name: Multiclass Prerequisites
multiclassPrereqs.Hint: Ability score requirements for taking a level in a new class.

allowGold.Name: Offer Starting Gold
allowGold.Hint: Let players take starting wealth instead of the equipment package.

defaultBackdrop.Name: Default Backdrop
defaultBackdrop.Hint: Image or video shown behind the wizard when an option has no art of its own.

playerCreation.Name: Create Through GM
playerCreation.Hint: Players without the core Create Actor permission can still finish the wizard; an online GM's client creates the character for them.

actorFolder.Name: Character Folder
actorFolder.Hint: Name of an existing Actors folder to put new characters in (blank for none).

assignCharacter.Name: Assign as Player Character
assignCharacter.Hint: Set the new actor as the player's assigned character if they don't have one.

promptNewPlayers.Name: Prompt New Players
promptNewPlayers.Hint: Offer the wizard to players who log in without a character.

sidebarButton.Name: Sidebar Button
sidebarButton.Hint: Show a Create Character button in the Actors sidebar.

Wizard.ExitContent: Your choices are saved as a draft so you can pick up where you left off.

Draft.Title: Unfinished Character
Draft.Content: You have a character in progress. Continue where you left off?

class.Heading: Choose Your Class
class.Empty: No classes were found in your compendiums. Check the dnd5e Compendium Browser sources and the Rules Edition setting.

subclass.Heading: Choose Your Subclass
subclass.Empty: No subclasses were found for this class.

background.Heading: Choose Your Background
background.Empty: No backgrounds were found in your compendiums.

birthsign.Heading: Choose Your Birthsign
birthsign.Empty: No birthsigns were found. Make sure the Birthsigns of Tamriel compendium is enabled, or create feats of type Birthsign.

species.Heading: Choose Your Species
species.Empty: No species were found in your compendiums.

Birthsign.Quote: The skies are marked with numberless sparks, each a fire, and every one a sign.

Abilities.Title: Ability Scores

Subtitle.pointBuy: Spend points to increase your ability scores
Subtitle.roll: Roll 4d6 six times, drop the lowest die, and assign the totals
Subtitle.manual: Enter the scores your table agreed on

Abilities.BackgroundNote: {name} will let you raise some of these during Features & Choices.
Abilities.Incomplete: Give every ability a score first.
Abilities.PointsLeft: You still have {points} points to spend. Continue anyway?
Abilities.NoReroll: Your GM has disabled rerolling ability scores.

Features.Title: Features & Choices
Features.Hint: Your background, species, and class now grant their features. You'll be asked for any choices they need, such as skills, languages, and feats.
Features.Stale: You changed earlier choices since these features were applied. Rebuild to update them.
Features.Missing: Choose a class and ability scores first.

Spells.NeedFeatures: Apply your features first; your spellcasting depends on them.
Spells.NoCasting: This character doesn't cast spells yet.
Spells.NoList: No spell list is registered for this class, so every spell is shown. Set the spell list in Spell Rules.
Spells.Empty: No spells are available at this level.
Spells.InspectHint: Hover or select a spell to read it.
Spells.Remaining: {name}: {cantrips} cantrip(s) and {spells} spell(s) left to choose.
Spells.ContinueAnyway: Continue anyway? You can add spells later from your sheet.
Spells.ReplaceHint: On gaining a level you may swap up to {max} known spell(s): click a spell above to forget it, then pick its replacement below.
Spells.ReplaceToggle: Forget this spell and choose a replacement
Spells.ReplaceLimit: You can only replace {max} spell(s) this level.

Equipment.Hint: Take your class and background equipment packages, or their starting gold instead.
Equipment.Incomplete: Make every equipment choice (or take gold) first.

LevelUp.Title: Level Up
LevelUp.PolicyWarn: Multiclass requirements are shown but not enforced.
LevelUp.PickClass: Choose which class gains the level.
LevelUp.Blocked: You don't meet the requirements for that class.
LevelUp.ApplyHint: The class's new features and choices are applied to your character now.
LevelUp.NoActor: Select a character to level up.

SpellRules.Title: Spell Rules
SpellRules.Hint: Configure spell selection rules per class (showing {edition} defaults). Saved rules override class data and the built-in tables.
SpellRules.Formula: Spells = ability modifier + class level ÷ {divisor}. Leave the row blank to keep this formula.

Sources.Title: Content Sources
Sources.Hint: Check the compendium packs the wizard should use. Checked packs are the only source for every category they contain; categories they don't contain (for example weapons for equipment picks) fall back to all packs. Checked packs are shown regardless of the Rules Edition setting.
Sources.StatusNone: No packs selected: using every pack enabled in the dnd5e Compendium Browser sources.

Artwork.Title: Artwork
Artwork.Hint: Splash art shown behind each option. Images and videos (webm/mp4) both work. Without an override, art embedded in the item's description is used.
Artwork.Placeholder: Backdrop: path or URL to an image or video
Artwork.FigurePlaceholder: Character figure: transparent image (default: bundled class art)

Errors.RelayDisabled: The GM has turned off character creation for players.
Errors.NoGM: A GM needs to be online to create your character.
Errors.RelayTimeout: The GM's client didn't respond. Is a GM logged in?
Errors.NotBuilt: Apply your features before creating the character.
Errors.NoPermission: You don't have permission to create characters.
Errors.CreateFailed: The character could not be created.
Errors.Wasm: Character Genesis couldn't load its rules engine (wasm/genesis_rules.wasm).
Errors.System: Character Genesis requires the dnd5e system.

Prompt.Title: Create Your Character
Prompt.Content: You don't have a character yet. Would you like to create one now?
